name: peer-message
description: Write agent-to-agent messages that end the thread instead of starting another round trip.

interface.shortDescription: Write messages another agent will read.
interface.longDescription: A transport-neutral format for agent-to-agent messages: an ACT/RE/NEED/REF header, claims marked verified or unverified, pointers instead of payloads, anchors that survive compaction, and the discipline to send nothing when a message would change nothing.
defaultPrompt: Write this handoff as a message for another agent.
Send the other session what it needs to unblock.
Draft a dissent to my peer's conclusion.
